before.requirement: Recognize and render a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum has no spoiler type, and the before collector treats pipes as table or wiki-link marks.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, recognize ||text|| and emit x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag, delimiter handling, span callbacks and HTML tags are supplied. The omitted analysis caller path is decisive for establishing that the harness input reaches them.

source_evidence.quote:
#define MD_FLAG_HARD_SOFT_BREAKS            0x8000  /* Force all soft breaks to act as hard breaks. */
#define MD_FLAG_SPOILERS                    0x10000 /* Enable ||hidden text|| spoiler spans. */

claims.reason: The spoiler contract did not exist before the change. Afterward, the old harness supplies the required flag and bytes, but the supplied source does not establish their complete route to spoiler resolution.
